core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abdelwahab is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Servant of the Bestower”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abdelwahab represents the Arabic compound عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب (ʿAbd al-Wahhāb). The name combines عبد (“servant”) with al-Wahhāb, whose sense is al-Wahhāb (the Bestower). This is a compound name, not a single unmodified lexical word.

faq.a: Abdelwahab represents Arabic عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب, meaning servant of al-Wahhāb (the Bestower).

faq.q: What is the origin of Abdelwahab?
faq.a: The name is Arabic and is a compound of عبد and a second element.
Yes. The underlying compound is عَبْدُ الْوَهَّاب (ʿAbd al-Wahhāb).

faq.q: What is the root of Abdelwahab?
faq.a: عبد is related to ع ب د; al-Wahhāb is related to و ه ب (w-h-b).
Abdelwahab is a traditional Muslim personal name because it contains a compound invoking al-Wahhāb, a divine epithet in Islamic tradition.
This record does not establish Abdelwahab as an explicitly named Qur'anic person; the compound's religious meaning is distinct from personal-name attestation in the text.

faq.q: What does Abdelwahab mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, the name means servant of al-Wahhāb (the Bestower); the compound combines عبد with al-Wahhāb.
The supplied “ab-del-wa-hab” is an approximate pronunciation; local pronunciations vary.

faq.q: Is Abdelwahab a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: The record classifies the name as masculine, consistent with traditional usage; regional frequency data is not supplied.
